To pass
10+correct (20 marks)
  • Result is what counts. Column order and aliases do not matter. Row order matters only when the question asks you to sort.
  • Run as often as you like. Press Ctrl + Enter (⌘ + Enter on Mac) to execute. Your queries are saved as you move between questions.
  • Practise safely. If you change the data, use Reset database. Grading always runs on a fresh copy of the original 50 rows.
  • Answers appear after you submit. You then see your score, pass or fail, and the model solution for every question.
